Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary biological variable is the treatment of naïve RBCs with extracellular vesicles (EVs) derived from either infected (Pf-iRBC) or uninfected (uRBC) cells. While the study also uses proteasome inhibitors (bortezomib) and kinase inhibitors, these are used in functional assays and not in the primary phosphoproteomics MS dataset (PXD018154). The mapping is set to ligand_stimulation as EVs act as extracellular signaling vehicles delivering cargo. No specific child class in the ontology perfectly fits 'extracellular vesicle treatment', so the parent category is used.
